spans.text: Z-W Pharma's third-floor office area.
After an intense battle, the floor is littered with S.F. remains.
Dreamer, we're the only ones left!
I have eyes, you know. I don't need you to tell me.
But what will we do now? What's your next plan?
Oh, my next plan?
How about getting on our knees and begging for mercy?
How can you make such lame jokes at a time like this!
A lame joke, huh...
I thought you could do everything!
You've always been able to come up with the perfect plan!
Why not now?
You've been like this ever since Elisa left...
I don't even know why you've been dragging your feet when it comes to fixing me either; there's been no progress and all...
In the past, you were always able to finish things up quickly, whether it was modding me or rebuilding my body!
Are you even doing your best to help me? Even I can't bear to see how pathetic you've become now!
Oh my, I guess even a pupper has the audacity to bark at me. I must have hit rock bottom.
Y-You're just sad! I hate the way you are now!
Dammit, when did my power cable get cut?
I'm starting to see stars again...
Infighting, is it...
45, what should we do?
I'm contacting the Com—
You don't have any more S.F. minions to take bullets for you. Time for you to die!
After ensuring that Anna is safe, 416 raises her gun and takes aim at Dreamer.
I didn't expect things to end so soon.
Dreamer closes her eyes.
Bang—
You're not allowed...to die first...
Dreamer's eyes snap open.
The Doll that's standing in front of her has crashed once again.
Perhaps she's imagining things, but Dreamer feels an ache in her little finger.
Several days ago.
How many days has it been? Why haven't you fixed me yet?
I'm tired of being leashed to a power outlet!
If you're tired of living like this, you can always choose the other option.
Humph, no matter which option I choose, all I need to do is die before you.
...I didn't know you had such a strong competitive streak.
Besides, you can live on just fine without me.
But if I were alone, I wouldn't know where to go or how to survive.
How unusual. Turns out idiots can be pretty self-aware too.
Therefore, I've decided..
Destroyer yanks a few strands of her hair free and messily ties them around Dreamer's little finger.
This is what humans do to signify a promise!
It's a deal, you can't die before me.
Dreamer glares at the long strand of white hair cinching her little finger. Her pocket holds nine other strands of hair that are now a messy ball.
Dreamer knows that Destroyer doesn't remember this is the tenth time she's made this promise today.
...You do realize...
What?
Our hair isn't like human hair. It doesn't grow back by itself.
Huh?!
You kept yammering about how pathetic I was, but when the time came, you rushed up to take a bullet for me.
You really are...a loyal little pup.
Dreamer sneers and tosses aside her weapon, which has long since run out of ammo.
Stop, 416. The Commander has something else in mind.
Why does she always have someone ready to die for her?!
I applaud you for holding out this long.
Is wasting time on spouting nonsense in battle a Griffin specialty?
Destroyer has crashed, so you can drop the act and stop pretending you've got things under control.
I didn't know I needed to put on a show in front of an idiot like that.
Destroyer had suffered extensive damage at the Paldiski Submarine Base, hadn't she?
It wasn't just her body. Even her neural cloud was affected.
You've been stripping out your own parts just to keep her running.
You're much slower than you used to be according to our combat logs.
I thought that was as far as you'd go for her.
But when I got close to Destroyer, I spotted your name on her power-link data cable.
Don't tell me you've even given her your battery?
Having the same voice whine and nag into my ear all day log is a nuisance.
If I could shut her up just by changing out my battery, of course I'd jump at the chance.
But changing the battery didn't solve the issue. The fact is...Destroyer's problems were so complex that they're beyond your ability to fix.
The only chance to properly repair her would be to return her to the factory.
Well, the bugs in an idiot's head aren't exactly fixable using conventional methods.
Yet you kept all this from Destroyer.
Her mental capacity was so pitifully limited. Giving her all that information would have made her brains explode.
You really are a foolish pair of sisters.
You're out of moves, or should I say you've long since been out of them.
But you kept pretending to be totally on top of things, all just to maintain the illusion for Destroyer?
Well, I AM called Dreamer, after all.
You know how human entrepreneurs work. They paint a lovely pie-in-the-sky picture so that their minions would take hits for them.
So, how long of an expiry date does your pie have?
Why are you acting like a success counselor ready to dispense guidance?
Because I actually do have a pretty good proposal for you.
UMP45 turns her communicator's screen to face Dreamer.
It's been a while, Dreamer.
So you're still alive, Griffin Commander.
...Alive, and living well.
Griffin's already started rebuilding. We've got a big base and we can take in a lot of Dolls.
The dorms are nice; the meal portions are big; we get annual leave every year...
Please get to the point. After all, a Doll's final moments are precious.
What I'm saying is that just because we used to be enemies doesn't mean we always have to be enemies.
Sangvis Ferri is now in shambles. Elisa's gone, you've taken a major beating, and your forces are scattered all over the place.
Although Griffin has also barely escaped a lethal blow, I believe that everything will get better under my leadership.
But that is nowhere near enough. The enemies we'll have to face are very powerful, and we need to recruit greater strength, such as you.
Well, isn't that touching.
Therefore, I would like to bring Sangvis Ferri into Griffin's fold.
I hope you will continue to grow and develop in the Griffin base, and seek revenge on our mutual enemies.
Of course, Griffin will provide you with the things you need, such as a stable environment, repair bays, training facilities...
So to sum up your long-winded spiel, we're still going be enslaved and put to work; it will just be under a new slave driver.
Well, I'm honestly exhausted. All I want is to be left in peace, so that I can live out the rest of my days as a pathetic piece of junk, until all my parts finally give out.
Then what about Destroyer?
She's my pup. I'll take care of her until the end. She isn't your problem.
So, can we shoot them now?
Hold on.
45, let them go.
Griffin Commander, aren't you afraid this will turn into a reenactment of "The Farmer and the Viper"?
It could just as well be "Crane's Return of a Favor".
Well, whether you're a viper or a crane, my offer still stands.
The transmission ends.
What the hell is wrong with the Commander?!
416, wanna pinch Anna's cheeks to cool off?
Gr G11's cheeks do the job better...
Well, you heard the Commander. Shouldn't you scamper off while you have the chance?
Every one of you in Griffin is weirder than the last.
Dreamer scoops up a stiff Destroyer and prepares to leave.
Oh yes, your new pet seems to like this medicine very much.
UMP45 catches the object Dreamer throws at her.
When she looks up again, Dreamer is gone.
Well, wasn't that a stylish exit. She didn't even transfer the server data.
Doesn't that mean we get to take it?
Unfortunately, all the data files were wiped a long time ago. All that's left are a few Sangvis maintenance logs. I wonder how much we can recover once we bring it back.
At the very least, we can turn something in.
Stop gawking, 416. They're not coming back.
Are they really going to throw in with Griffin?
Who knows? The next time you see them, they might be on a Svarog Heavy Industries capture list.
UMP45 grins and reveals a Svarog HI target designator in her hand.
